./PROJECT.md:1:# 2D Maxwell--PML Energy Functional Exploration
./PROJECT.md:3:Goal: prepare a precise mathematical source problem for exploring monotone or dissipative energy functionals for the two-dimensional Maxwell--PML system, with a staged Cole--Cole fractional extension.
./ITERIS_INPUT_GUIDE.md:21:Analyze sources/energy_functional_problem.tex. The model is the displayed 2D Maxwell--PML system with P, P_{z,1}, P_{z,2}, Q_x, Q_y and PEC boundary condition. Start with the alpha = 1 case of P + tau^alpha partial_t^alpha P = chi E; do not remove P from the model. Search first for a monotone decreasing energy functional in two dimensions. If no monotone energy can be found, derive the strongest bounded-energy/no-abnormal-growth estimate possible, in the spirit of MPML long-time stability, or identify a verified obstruction for natural quadratic energies. Only after the alpha = 1 model is understood, examine whether the fractional case 0 < alpha < 1 can be added as a positive memory energy. Write the final result to results/energy_functional_report.md.

./memory/facts/fact-2d_maxwell_pml_energy_functional_exploration-v2-covariant-model-not-perfectly-matched.md:18:For a planar x-interface with constant layer coefficient rho_x=rho>0, rho_y=0, Laplace parameter Re s>0, and tangential Fourier number k_y, the physical Maxwell-Debye admittance is Y0^2=A(s)/mu+k_y^2/(mu^2 s^2), where A(s)=epsilon0 epsilon_infty+chi/(1+tau s). ./memory/facts/fact-2d_maxwell_pml_energy_functional_exploration-alpha1-algebra-balance.md:18:For the source 2D TM Maxwell-PML system with alpha=1 polarization law P + tau P_t = chi E and PEC boundary condition E=0 on dOmega, multiplying the first three equations by E,H_x,H_y and integrating gives the electromagnetic balance displayed in the source: the principal Maxwell contribution is the boundary flux integral int_dOmega E(H_y n_x - H_x n_y) ds and vanishes under PEC. The alpha=1 identity E P_t = (1/(2 chi)) d_t ||P||_2^2 + (tau/chi)||P_t||_2^2 makes E_em + (1/(2 chi))||P||_2^2 positive and adds dissipation (tau/chi)||P_t||_2^2. With a_x=(sigma_y-sigma_x)/epsilon_0, a_y=(sigma_x-sigma_y)/epsilon_0, b_x=sigma_x/epsilon_0, b_y=sigma_y/epsilon_0, and M_x=Q_x-mu a_x H_x, M_y=Q_y-mu a_y H_y, the shifted equations are mu H_{x,t}=-partial_y E+M_x, mu H_{y,t}=partial_x E+M_y, M_{x,t}=a_x partial_y E-b_y M_x, and M_{y,t}=-a_y partial_x E-b_x M_y. Substituting Q_x=M_x+mu a_x H_x and Q_y=M_y+mu a_y H_y cancels the sign-indefinite magnetic square terms in the E_em+P balance and leaves the magnetic coupling H_x M_x+H_y M_y. ./memory/facts/fact-2d_maxwell_pml_energy_functional_exploration-run-20260619T173930696222Z-source-problem.md:17:\documentclass[UTF8,a4paper,12pt]{ctexart} \input{macros} \title{Problem Sheet for Iteris: Energy Functionals for 2D Maxwell--PML} \author{Prepared source problem} \date{\today} \begin{document} \maketitle \begin{abstract} This note is a self-contained source problem for an Iteris run. The system to be analyzed is the two-dimensional TM Maxwell--PML model with polarization \(P\), PML auxiliary variables \(P_{z,1},P_{z,2},Q_x,Q_y\), and perfectly conducting boundary condition. The first target is to find a genuinely monotone decreasing energy functional in two space dimensions. If such a monotone energy cannot be found, the fallback target is to find a positive energy functional that proves boundedness/no abnormal long-time growth, in the same spirit as the long-time-stability role of MPML.

The stage-3 artifact proves planar-interface perfect matching for the stretched-coordinate Maxwell-Debye model by keeping the Debye law as (1+tau s)P=chi E and applying S_i^{-1} only to spatial derivatives; at an x-interface with S_y=1 the PML normal symbol satisfies nu=S_x nu0 and the admittance equals the physical admittance. The ADE realization of S_i^{-1}=s/(s+sigma_i) yields the displayed auxiliary variables, and differentiating the naive physical Debye energy gives the negative Debye dissipation term plus the memory couplings E(psi_E,x-psi_E,y)-H_x psi_Hx,y+H_y psi_Hy,x. ./verification/agent_runs/verify-20260620T070357651402Z-assembly-stage-3-terminal-report-results/codex.events.jsonl:19:{"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"item_6","type":"command_execution","command":"/bin/zsh -lc \"sed -n '1,320p' artifacts/proofs/stage3_repaired_model_energy.md\"","aggregated_output":"# Stage-3 proof: repaired PML candidates and dissipative-energy classification\n\nProblem id: `2d_maxwell_pml_energy_functional_exploration`\n\nTask: `task-stage3-repaired-model-energy`\n\n## Input fact from the matching test\n\nThe v2 covariantly damped Maxwell--Debye model has the verified stage-2 monotone\nenergy identity, but the stage-3 interface calculation shows that it is not a\nperfectly matched layer.  In an \\(x\\)-layer with \\(\\rho_x=\\rho>0,\\rho_y=0\\),\n\\[\nY_{v2}^2-Y_0^2\n=-\\frac{\\rho}{\\mu^2}\\left[\n\\frac{\\mu\\chi\\tau}{(1+\\tau s)(1+\\tau(s+\\rho))}\n+\\frac{k_y^2}{s^2(s+\\rho)}\n\\right],\n\\]\nso the v2 reflection coefficient is not identically zero.\n\nTherefore a repaired model must keep the physical Debye law as a function of the\nLaplace variable \\(s\\), not \\(s+\\rho\\), and must implement damping through\ncoordinate stretching or an equivalent split/ADE system.\n\n## Candidate 1: classical stretched-coordinate Maxwell--Debye PML\n\nLet\n\\[\n\\varepsilon_D(s)=\\epsilon_0\\epsilon_\\infty+\\frac{\\chi}{1+\\tau s},\n\\qquad\nS_i(s)=1+\\frac{\\sigma_i}{s},\\quad i=x,y.\n\\]\nIn the physical region \\(\\sigma_x=\\sigma_y=0\\).  In the PML the coefficients are\nnonnegative and are first analyzed as piecewise constant near each planar\ninterface.\n\nThe Laplace-domain repaired model is\n\\[\n\\boxed{\ns\\varepsilon_D(s)\\widehat E\n=S_x^{-1}\\partial_x\\widehat H_y\n-S_y^{-1}\\partial_y\\widehat H_x,}\n\\]\n\\[\n\\boxed{\n\\mu s\\widehat H_x=-S_y^{-1}\\partial_y\\widehat E,\\qquad\n\\mu s\\widehat H_y=S_x^{-1}\\partial_x\\widehat E,}\n\\]\n\\[\n\\boxed{(1+\\tau s)\\widehat P=\\chi\\widehat E.}\n\\]\nEquivalently, the Debye law is not damped:\n\\[\nP+\\tau P_t=\\chi E.\n\\]\n\n### Perfect matching\n\nAt an \\(x\\)-interface, \\(S_y=1\\).  With tangential Fourier number \\(k_y\\),\nthe physical normal symbol satisfies\n\\[\n\\nu_0^2=k_y^2+\\mu s^2\\varepsilon_D(s),\\qquad\nY_0=\\frac{\\nu_0}{\\mu s}.\n\\]\nIn the PML,\n\\[\ns\\varepsilon_D E=S_x^{-1}\\nu H_y-ik_yH_x,\\qquad\n\\mu sH_x=-ik_yE,\\qquad\n\\mu sH_y=S_x^{-1}\\nu E.\n\\]\nThe dispersion relation gives\n\\[\n\\left(S_x^{-1}\\nu\\right)^2=k_y^2+\\mu s^2\\varepsilon_D(s),\n\\]\nhence \\(\\nu=S_x\\nu_0\\) and\n\\[\nY_+=\\frac{S_x^{-1}\\nu}{\\mu s}=\\frac{\\nu_0}{\\mu s}=Y_0.\n\\]\nThus the planar-interface reflection coefficient is \\(R=0\\) for every\n\\((s,k_y)\\) in the Laplace half-plane.  The same argument applies to a\n\\(y\\)-interface with \\(x,y\\) interchanged.\n\n### Time-domain ADE realization\n\nDefine the causal operator\n\\[\n\\mathcal A_i=S_i^{-1}=\\frac{s}{s+\\sigma_i}\n\\]\nin the Laplace domain.  Equivalently,\n\\[\n\\mathcal A_i f=f+\\psi_i,\\qquad\n(\\partial_t+\\sigma_i)\\psi_i=-\\sigma_i f.\n\\]\nThen a time-domain unsplit ADE form is\n\\[\n\\epsilon_0\\epsilon_\\infty E_t+P_t\n=\\partial_xH_y-\\partial_yH_x\n+\\psi_{E,x}-\\psi_{E,y},\n\\]\n\\[\n\\mu H_{x,t}=-\\partial_yE-\\psi_{H_x,y},\\qquad\n\\mu H_{y,t}=\\partial_xE+\\psi_{H_y,x},\n\\]\n\\[\nP+\\tau P_t=\\chi E,\n\\]\nwith\n\\[\n(\\partial_t+\\sigma_x)\\psi_{E,x}=-\\sigma_x\\partial_xH_y,\\qquad\n(\\partial_t+\\sigma_y)\\psi_{E,y}=-\\sigma_y\\partial_yH_x,\n\\]\n\\[\n(\\partial_t+\\sigma_y)\\psi_{H_x,y}=-\\sigma_y\\partial_yE,\\qquad\n(\\partial_t+\\sigma_x)\\psi_{H_y,x}=-\\sigma_x\\partial_xE.\n\\]\nInterface conditions are continuity of the physical tangential traces.  For an\n\\(x\\)-interface these are \\(E\\) and \\(H_y\\).  The auxiliary variables vanish in the\nphysical region and are initialized consistently with the causal convolution.\n\n### Naive energy calculation\n\nThe natural physical Debye energy is\n\\[\n\\mathcal E_{\\rm phys}\n=\\frac12\\int_\\Omega\n\\left(\\epsilon_0\\epsilon_\\infty E^2+\\mu H_x^2+\\mu H_y^2+\\chi^{-1}P^2\\right)\\,dxdy.\n\\]\nIt is positive because\n\\(\\epsilon_0,\\epsilon_\\infty,\\mu,\\chi>0\\).  Using\n\\[\nE P_t=\\frac{1}{2\\chi}\\partial_t(P^2)+\\frac{\\tau}{\\chi}P_t^2\n\\]\nand the PEC boundary condition \\(E=0\\) on the outer boundary gives\n\\[\n\\frac{d}{dt}\\mathcal E_{\\rm phys}\n=-\\int_\\Omega\\frac{\\tau}{\\chi}P_t^2\\,dxdy\n+\\int_\\Omega\n\\left[\nE(\\psi_{E,x}-\\psi_{E,y})\n-H_x\\psi_{H_x,y}\n+H_y\\psi_{H_y,x}\n\\right]\\,dxdy .\n\\]\nThe Maxwell principal part contributes only the boundary flux\n\\[\n\\int_{\\partial\\Omega}E(H_y n_x-H_x n_y)\\,ds,\n\\]\nwhich vanishes under PEC at the outer boundary and cancels by transmission at\ninternal material/PML interfaces when the tangential traces are continuous.\n\nThe remaining auxiliary terms are not sign-definite in this naive energy.\nTherefore the positive physical Debye energy alone is not a monotone energy for\nthe exact stretched-coordinate PML.\n\n### Classification\n\nThis candidate is the formula-level perfect-matching repair.  A local monotone\nenergy for the full 2D Maxwell--Debye ADE system is not certified here.  The\ncalculation above identifies the exact terms that a Baffet-type augmented energy\nwould have to absorb:\n\\[\nE\\psi_{E,x},\\quad E\\psi_{E,y},\\quad\nH_x\\psi_{H_x,y},\\quad H_y\\psi_{H_y,x}.\n\\]\nThe literature record supports that such augmented energies are non-naive and\nthat constant-coefficient damping is the natural first scope for a sharp identity.\n\n### Reduced normal-incidence 1D energy identity\n\nThere is one important positive result for the exact stretched-coordinate model.\nIn the \\(x\\)-layer normal-incidence block \\(k_y=0\\), the standard stretch gives\n\\[\n(\\partial_t+\\rho)(\\epsilon_0\\epsilon_\\infty E+P)=\\partial_xH_y,\n\\qquad\n\\mu(\\partial_t+\\rho)H_y=\\partial_xE,\n\\]\n\\[\nP+\\tau P_t=\\chi E.\n\\]\nThis is exactly the \\(k_y=0\\) restriction of the perfectly matched stretched\nmodel, not the v2 model, because the Debye law still uses \\(\\partial_t\\) rather\nthan \\(\\partial_t+\\rho\\).\n\nMultiply the first equation by \\(E\\), the second by \\(H_y\\), and use\n\\[\nE=\\frac{P+\\tau P_t}{\\chi}.\n\\]\nThen\n\\[\nE P_t=\\frac{1}{2\\chi}\\partial_t(P^2)+\\frac{\\tau}{\\chi}P_t^2,\n\\]\nand\n\\[\n\\rho E P\n=\\frac{\\rho}{\\chi}P^2+\\frac{\\rho\\tau}{2\\chi}\\partial_t(P^2).\n\\]\nAfter integrating by parts, the principal terms give only the boundary flux\n\\(\\int_{\\partial I}EH_y n_x\\,ds\\).  Hence\n\\[\n\\boxed{\n\\frac{d}{dt}\\mathcal E_{1d,sc}\n=-\\int_I\\left(\n\\rho\\epsilon_0\\epsilon_\\infty E^2+\\mu\\rho H_y^2\n+\\frac{\\rho}{\\chi}P^2+\\frac{\\tau}{\\chi}P_t^2\n\\right)\\,dx\n+\\int_{\\partial I}EH_y n_x\\,ds,}\n\\]\nwhere\n\\[\n\\boxed{\n\\mathcal E_{1d,sc}\n=\\frac12\\int_I\\left(\n\\epsilon_0\\epsilon_\\infty E^2+\\mu H_y^2\n+\\frac{1+\\rho\\tau}{\\chi}P^2\n\\right)\\,dx.}\n\\]\nThis energy is positive for \\(\\rho,\\tau,\\chi>0\\), and it is dissipative under\nPEC or otherwise nonpositive boundary flux.  It explains why the v2 idea is\nclose to a useful construction in normal incidence, but it does not solve the\nfull 2D oblique problem: as soon as \\(k_y\\ne0\\), the exact stretched model\ncontains the ADE memory couplings displayed above.\n\n## Candidate 2: generalized CFS/ADE stretched-coordinate PML\n\nLet\n\\[\nS_i(s)=\\kappa_i+\\frac{\\sigma_i}{s+\\alpha_i},\n\\qquad\n\\kappa_i\\ge1,\\quad \\sigma_i\\ge0,\\quad \\alpha_i\\ge0.\n\\]\nThe repaired Laplace-domain equations are the same as Candidate 1, with these\n\\(S_i\\).  In particular the Debye law remains\n\\[\n(1+\\tau s)\\widehat P=\\chi\\widehat E.\n\\]\n\nFor a planar \\(x\\)-interface with \\(S_y=1\\), the same calculation gives\n\\[\n\\nu=S_x\\nu_0,\\qquad Y_+=Y_0,\n\\]\nso the continuous model is perfectly matched whenever the stretch is applied to\nthe spatial derivatives and the physical material law is left unchanged.\n\nIf \\(S_i^{-1}\\) is rational with poles in \\(\\Re s<0\\), it can be implemented by\nADE variables.  The CFS shift \\(\\alpha_i>0\\) is a standard way to improve\nlow-frequency/evanescent and late-time behavior, but a monotone time-domain\nenergy requires an explicit positive realization of the memory kernel.  No such\npositive memory theorem is claimed here for the full 2D Maxwell--Debye system.\n\nClassification: perfectly matched at the continuous planar-interface level;\nrecommended if long-time CFS behavior is needed; energy status is boundedness or\npassive-memory proof pending, not a completed monotone identity.\n\n## Candidate 3: MPML-type extra damping\n\nAn MPML-type repair adds damping in more than the normal coordinate direction.\nFor example, in an \\(x\\)-layer one may replace a scalar stretch by a multiaxial\nstretch depending also on tangential damping parameters.  This is useful for\nremoving long-time instabilities or Jordan-block behavior in some systems.\n\nHowever, if the tangential stretch is nontrivial at the physical/PML interface,\nthe planar admittance generally changes.  The MPML literature inspected for this\nrun explicitly treats MPML as a stability-oriented absorbing layer and records\nthat exact perfect matching may be lost in multiaxial variants.\n\nClassification: absorbing/stability repair, not the primary exact-matching\nrepair for the present Maxwell--Debye interface theorem.\n\n## Complete dissipative identity that is currently verified\n\nThe only complete positive monotone identity verified in the existing Iteris\nmemory is for the v2 covariantly damped absorbing layer:\n\\[\n\\epsilon_0\\epsilon_\\infty D_\\rho E\n=\\partial_xH_y-\\partial_yH_x-D_\\rho P,\n\\]\n\\[\n\\mu(\\partial_t+\\rho_y)H_x=-\\partial_yE,\\qquad\n\\mu(\\partial_t+\\rho_x)H_y=\\partial_xE,\n\\]\n\\[\nP+\\tau D_\\rho P=\\chi E,\\qquad D_\\rho=\\partial_t+\\rho_x+\\rho_y.\n\\]\nIts energy is\n\\[\n\\mathcal E_\\rho(t)=\\frac12\\int_\\Omega\n\\left(\\epsilon_0\\epsilon_\\infty E^2+\\mu H_x^2+\\mu H_y^2+\\chi^{-1}P^2\\right)\\,dxdy\n\\]\nand the verified identity is\n\\[\n\\frac{d}{dt}\\mathcal E_\\rho(t)\n=-\\int_\\Omega\\left(\n\\epsilon_0\\epsilon_\\infty\\rho E^2\n+\\mu\\rho_yH_x^2\n+\\mu\\rho_xH_y^2\n+\\frac{\\rho}{\\chi}P^2\n+\\frac{\\tau}{\\chi}|D_\\rho P|^2\n\\right)\\,dxdy.\n\\]\nThis identity is genuinely dissipative, but the model is not perfectly matched.\nIt should therefore be described as a stable absorbing-layer model, not as a\nstandard PML.\n\n## Formula-level obstruction to strict decay on the whole domain\n\nEven for a perfectly matched repair, strict decay of a total energy controlling\nall fields on the whole computational domain cannot hold without a nullspace.\nAssume a physical subregion where \\(\\sigma_x=\\sigma_y=0\\) and choose\n\\[\nE=0,\\qquad P=0,\\qquad H_x=\\partial_x\\phi,\\qquad H_y=\\partial_y\\phi,\n\\]\nwith \\(\\phi\\) smooth and compactly supported inside that undamped physical\nsubregion.  Then\n\\[\n\\partial_xH_y-\\partial_yH_x=0,\\qquad\n\\partial_yE=\\partial_xE=0,\n\\]\nand all PML auxiliary variables initialized at zero remain zero for at least this\nexact stationary solution.  The magnetic energy is positive if \\(\\nabla\\phi\\ne0\\),\nbut every damping term in the PML vanishes.\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

    64	\section{结论审查}
    65	
    66	本轮问题的最终目标仍是为二维 Maxwell--Debye--PML 构造正定能量泛函并证明
    67	\[
    68	\frac{\dd}{\dd t}\Ecal(t)+\Dcal(t)\le0,\qquad \Dcal(t)\ge0,
    69	\]
    70	同时不能牺牲 perfectly matched 性质。必须区分三个模型。
    71	
    72	\begin{enumerate}
    73	\item \textbf{strict stretched-coordinate Maxwell--Debye PML。}
    74	频域只替换空间导数
    75	\[
    76	\partial_i\mapsto S_i^{-1}\partial_i,\qquad S_i(s)=1+\frac{\sigma_i}{s},
    77	\]
    78	并保持物理 Debye law
    79	\[
    80	(1+\tau s)\widehat P=\kappa\widehat E.
    81	\]
    82	这是前一阶段推荐的最终 PML 主线。
    83	\item \textbf{Baffet primitive 形式。}
    84	令 \(E=u_t\)、\(q_t=P\)、\(q+\tau P=\kappa u\)，并引入
    85	\(\lambda=\nabla u+\phi\)。常系数时它与 strict stretched-coordinate PML 等价，
    86	且有非增能量。
    87	\item \textbf{port/weighted field 模型。}
    88	它有自然端口能量，对非负变系数阻尼无 \(\nabla\sigma\) 余项；但它不是一般斜入射
    89	perfectly matched 的模型。
    90	\end{enumerate}
    91	
    92	因此，新 PDF 的状态是：
    93	\begin{itemize}
    94	\item 它没有完成最终目标所需的无条件变系数 strict PML 单调能量。
    95	\item 它给出了 strict stretched-coordinate Baffet 能量的正确变量系数障碍
    96	\(R_\sigma\)，以及小梯度吸收的可写定理形式。
    97	\item 它给出的 port 模型是单调稳定吸收层；除特殊法向入射或非物理的频率/波数依赖
    98	\(\sigma_E\) 外，一般不是 perfectly matched。
    99	\item 因此 port 模型可用于数值稳定性设计，但 final PML theorem 仍应沿
   100	stretched-coordinate/Baffet primitive 主线处理 \(R_\sigma\)。
   101	\end{itemize}

   103	\section{Strict Baffet--Debye primitive 系统}
   104	
   105	设
   106	\[
   107	a(x,y)=\sx(x)+\sy(y),\qquad b(x,y)=\sx(x)\sy(y),
   108	\]
   109	\[
   110	\Gamma_1=\diag(\sx,\sy),\qquad
   111	\Gamma_2=\diag(\sy-\sx,\sx-\sy).
   112	\]
   113	在 \(\Omega_+=\{a>0\}\) 上，Baffet--Debye primitive 方程写作
   114	\begin{align}
   115	\mu\{\eps(u_{tt}+a u_t+b u)+P_t+aP+bq\}-\nabla\cdot\lambda&=0,
   116	\label{eq:baffet-main}\\
   117	\phi_t+\Gamma_1\phi&=\Gamma_2\nabla u,\label{eq:baffet-phi}\\
   118	\tau P_t+P&=\kappa u_t,\qquad q_t=P,\qquad q+\tau P=\kappa u.
   119	\label{eq:baffet-debye}
   120	\end{align}
   121	常系数时，\eqref{eq:baffet-phi} 在 Laplace 域给出
   122	\[
   123	\widehat\lambda_x=\frac{S_y}{S_x}\partial_x\widehat u,\qquad
   124	\widehat\lambda_y=\frac{S_x}{S_y}\partial_y\widehat u,
   125	\]
   126	而 Debye 兼容性给出
   127	\[
   128	\widehat P=\frac{\kappa s}{1+\tau s}\widehat u,\qquad \widehat q=\frac1s\widehat P.
   129	\]
   130	于是 \eqref{eq:baffet-main} 等价于从 strict stretched-coordinate
   131	Maxwell--Debye PML 消去磁场后的二阶方程。这个等价性是匹配性的来源；port 模型没有
   132	这个等价结构。
   133	
   134	\section{变系数 Baffet 能量逐式推导}
   135	
   136	定义
   137	\[
   138	W=u_t+a u.
   139	\]
   140	由于 \(a\) 与时间无关，
   141	\[
   142	\nabla W=\nabla u_t+a\nabla u+u\nabla a.
   143	\]
   144	这正是变量系数推导与常系数推导分叉的唯一内部位置。
   145	
   146	令
   147	\[
   148	\alpha=1+2a\tau,\qquad \beta=a+b\tau,\qquad
   149	\gamma=a^2+b(1+a\tau).
   150	\]
   151	Baffet--Debye 能量为
   152	\begin{equation}
   153	\begin{aligned}
   154	\Ecal_B(t)=\frac12\int_{\Omega_+}\{&
   155	\mu\eps W^2+|\lambda|^2+\phi^T a^{-1}\Gamma_1\phi+\mu\eps b u^2\\
   156	&+\frac{\mu}{\kappa}(\alpha P^2+2\beta Pq+\gamma q^2)\}\dd x\dd y.
   157	\end{aligned}
   158	\label{eq:EB}
   159	\end{equation}
   160	
   161	\subsection{主方程乘子恒等式}
   162	
   163	用 \(W\) 乘 \eqref{eq:baffet-main}，利用
   164	\[
   165	(u_{tt}+a u_t+b u)W=(W_t+b u)W,
   166	\]
   167	得到
   168	\[
   169	\begin{aligned}
   170	&\frac12\frac{\dd}{\dd t}\int_{\Omega_+}\mu\eps(W^2+b u^2)\dd x\dd y
   171	+\int_{\Omega_+}\mu\eps a b u^2\dd x\dd y\\
   172	&\quad=\int_{\Omega_+}W\nabla\cdot\lambda\dd x\dd y
   173	-\mu\int_{\Omega_+}(P_t+aP+bq)W\dd x\dd y .
   174	\end{aligned}
   175	\]
   176	分部积分给出
   177	\[
   178	\int_{\Omega_+}W\nabla\cdot\lambda
   179	=-\int_{\Omega_+}\nabla W\cdot\lambda
   180	+\int_{\partial\Omega_+}W\lambda\cdot n\,\dd s.
   181	\]
   182	
   183	\subsection{Baffet 通量恒等式}
   184	
   185	令 \(\widetilde\Gamma_2=\Gamma_1+\Gamma_2=\diag(\sy,\sx)\)。由
   186	\[
   187	\lambda_t+\Gamma_1\lambda=\nabla u_t+\widetilde\Gamma_2\nabla u
   188	\]
   189	和 Baffet 乘子
   190	\[
   191	g=(I+a^{-1}\Gamma_1)\lambda-a^{-1}\Gamma_1\nabla u
   192	\]
   193	逐分量得到
   194	\[
   195	\begin{aligned}
   196	&\frac12\frac{\dd}{\dd t}\int_{\Omega_+}
   197	\left(|\lambda|^2+\phi^Ta^{-1}\Gamma_1\phi\right)\dd x\dd y\\
   198	&\quad+\int_{\Omega_+}\left[
   199	|\lambda|^2_{\Gamma_1(I+a^{-1}\Gamma_1)}
   200	+\frac{b}{a}|\nabla u|^2
   201	\right]\dd x\dd y\\
   202	&\quad=\int_{\Omega_+}(\nabla u_t+a\nabla u)\cdot\lambda\dd x\dd y .
   203	\end{aligned}
   204	\]
   205	这里没有对空间变系数权重再分部积分，所以不会产生
   206	\(\nabla(a^{-1}\Gamma_1)\)；新的变量系数项只来自 \(\nabla W\)。
   207	
   208	\subsection{Debye primitive 乘积恒等式}
   209	
   210	由 \(q_t=P\) 与 \(q+\tau P=\kappa u\)，
   211	\[
   212	W=u_t+a u=\frac{\tau P_t+(1+a\tau)P+a q}{\kappa}.
   213	\]
   214	直接展开可得
   215	\begin{align}
   216	&(P_t+aP+bq)\bigl(\tau P_t+(1+a\tau)P+a q\bigr)\notag\\
   217	&\quad =
   218	\frac12\partial_t(\alpha P^2+2\beta Pq+\gamma q^2)
   219	+\tau P_t^2+\tau(a^2-b)P^2+abq^2.
   220	\label{eq:debye-identity}
   221	\end{align}
   222	SymPy 与 Lean 目标文件均覆盖了 \eqref{eq:debye-identity}。
   223	
   224	\subsection{变量系数余项}
   225	
   226	把三部分相加，常系数抵消
   227	\[
   228	-(\nabla u_t+a\nabla u)\cdot\lambda
   229	+(\nabla u_t+a\nabla u)\cdot\lambda=0
   230	\]
   231	仍然成立，但剩下
   232	\[
   233	-u\nabla a\cdot\lambda.
   234	\]
   235	因此
   236	\begin{equation}
   237	\boxed{
   238	\frac{\dd}{\dd t}\Ecal_B(t)=-D_0(t)+R_\sigma(t)+B(t)}
   239	\label{eq:variable-identity}
   240	\end{equation}
   241	其中
   242	\[
   243	B(t)=\int_{\partial\Omega_+}(u_t+a u)\lambda\cdot n\,\dd s,
   244	\]
   245	\[
   246	\boxed{
   247	R_\sigma(t)=-\int_{\Omega_+}u\,\nabla a\cdot\lambda\,\dd x\dd y
   248	=-\int_{\Omega_+}u(\sx'(x)\lambda_x+\sy'(y)\lambda_y)\dd x\dd y.}
   249	\]
   250	理想耗散为
   251	\begin{equation}
   252	\begin{aligned}
   253	D_0(t)=\int_{\Omega_+}\{&
   254	|\lambda|^2_{\Gamma_1(I+a^{-1}\Gamma_1)}
   255	+\frac{b}{a}|\nabla u|^2+\mu\eps a b u^2\\
   256	&+\frac{\mu}{\kappa}[\tau P_t^2+\tau(a^2-b)P^2+abq^2]\}\dd x\dd y.
   257	\end{aligned}
   258	\label{eq:D0}
   259	\end{equation}

     2	"""Symbolic checks for the variable-coefficient Baffet-Debye analysis.
     3	
     4	The script verifies the algebra used in the v5 report:
     5	
     6	* Debye primitive multiplier identity and P,q determinant.
     7	* 2 a^2 - b expansion for a = sigma_x + sigma_y, b = sigma_x sigma_y.
     8	* Variable-coefficient multiplier gradient term.
     9	* Small-gradient absorption Schur complement.
    10	* Port-model Maxwell cross-term cancellation.
    11	* Port-model Laplace-Fourier admittance mismatch.
    12	"""
    13	
    14	from __future__ import annotations
    15	
    16	import sympy as sp
    17	
    18	
    19	def reduced(expr: sp.Expr) -> sp.Expr:
    20	    return sp.factor(sp.cancel(sp.together(sp.expand(expr))))
    21	
    22	
    23	def check_zero(name: str, expr: sp.Expr) -> None:
    24	    value = reduced(expr)
    25	    print(f"{name}: {value}")
    26	    assert value == 0, name
    27	
    28	
    29	def check_equal(name: str, lhs: sp.Expr, rhs: sp.Expr) -> None:
    30	    check_zero(name, lhs - rhs)
    31	
    32	
    33	sx, sy, tau = sp.symbols("sigma_x sigma_y tau", positive=True)
    34	Pt, P, q = sp.symbols("P_t P q")
    35	
    36	a = sx + sy
    37	b = sx * sy
    38	alpha = 1 + 2 * a * tau
    39	beta = a + b * tau
    40	gamma = a**2 + b * (1 + a * tau)
    41	
    42	print("=== Debye primitive algebra ===")
    43	lhs = (Pt + a * P + b * q) * (tau * Pt + (1 + a * tau) * P + a * q)
    44	energy_derivative_part = Pt * (alpha * P + beta * q) + beta * P**2 + gamma * P * q
    45	rhs = (
    46	    energy_derivative_part
    47	    + tau * Pt**2
    48	    + tau * (a**2 - b) * P**2
    49	    + a * b * q**2
    50	)
    51	check_equal("Debye primitive product identity", lhs, rhs)
    52	
    53	det_pq = alpha * gamma - beta**2
    54	det_sum = b + a * b * tau + 2 * a**3 * tau + b * (2 * a**2 - b) * tau**2
    55	check_equal("P,q determinant identity", det_pq, det_sum)
    56	check_equal(
    57	    "2*a^2-b nonnegative expansion",
    58	    2 * a**2 - b,
    59	    2 * sx**2 + 3 * sx * sy + 2 * sy**2,
    60	)
    61	print(f"a^2-b = {sp.expand(a**2 - b)}")
    62	
    63	print("\n=== Variable-coefficient multiplier term ===")
    64	utx, u, ux, ax = sp.symbols("u_tx u u_x a_x")
    65	check_equal(
    66	    "component product-rule expansion for grad(u_t+a*u)",
    67	    utx + ax * u + a * ux,
    68	    utx + a * ux + u * ax,
    69	)
    70	
    71	print("\n=== Small-gradient absorption Schur complement ===")
    72	m_u, m_lam, g, lam = sp.symbols("m_u m_lambda g lambda", positive=True)
    73	positive_form = m_u * u**2 + m_lam * lam**2 - g * u * lam
    74	sos_rhs = (2 * m_u * u - g * lam) ** 2 + (4 * m_u * m_lam - g**2) * lam**2
    75	check_equal(
    76	    "absorption sum-of-squares identity",
    77	    4 * m_u * positive_form,
    78	    sos_rhs,
    79	)
    80	schur_condition = sp.factor(m_u * m_lam - (g / 2) ** 2)
    81	print(f"Schur complement m_u*m_lambda-(g/2)^2 = {schur_condition}")
    82	print("Thus g^2 <= 4*m_u*m_lambda is exactly the 2x2 absorption condition.")
    83	
    84	print("\n=== Port-model energy cross-term cancellation ===")
    85	E, Wx, Wy = sp.symbols("E W_x W_y")
    86	Ex, Ey, Wxy, Wyx = sp.symbols("E_x E_y W_x_y W_y_x")
    87	maxwell_cross = E * (Wyx - Wxy) - Wx * Ey + Wy * Ex
    88	boundary_divergence = Ex * Wy + E * Wyx - Ey * Wx - E * Wxy
    89	check_equal(
    90	    "port Maxwell cross terms equal div(E*W_y, -E*W_x)",
    91	    maxwell_cross,
    92	    boundary_divergence,
    93	)
    94	
    95	kappa = sp.symbols("kappa", positive=True)
    96	check_equal(
    97	    "Debye port product identity",
    98	    ((P + tau * Pt) / kappa) * Pt,
    99	    (sp.Rational(1, 2) / kappa) * (2 * P * Pt) + tau * Pt**2 / kappa,
   100	)
   101	
   102	print("\n=== Strict stretched-coordinate admittance ===")
   103	mu, eps, s, sig, ky, nu0 = sp.symbols(
   104	    "mu epsilon s sigma k_y nu_0", positive=True
   105	)
   106	eps_D = eps + kappa / (1 + tau * s)
   107	Sx = 1 + sig / s
   108	nu_plus = Sx * nu0
   109	Y_sc = (nu_plus / Sx) / (mu * s)
   110	Y0 = nu0 / (mu * s)
   111	check_equal("strict stretched-coordinate admittance", Y_sc, Y0)
   112	
   113	print("\n=== Port-model Laplace-Fourier mismatch ===")
   114	sigma_E = sp.symbols("sigma_E")
   115	Y0_sq = eps_D / mu + ky**2 / (mu**2 * s**2)
   116	Yport_sq = (s * eps_D + eps * sigma_E) / (mu * (s + sig)) + ky**2 / (
   117	    mu**2 * s * (s + sig)
   118	)
   119	port_mismatch = (eps * sigma_E - sig * eps_D) / (mu * (s + sig)) - sig * ky**2 / (
   120	    mu**2 * s**2 * (s + sig)
   121	)
   122	check_equal("port squared-admittance mismatch", Yport_sq - Y0_sq, port_mismatch)
   123	
   124	sigma_E_normal = sig * eps_D / eps
   125	check_equal(
   126	    "port normal-incidence matching with dispersive sigma_E",
   127	    port_mismatch.subs({sigma_E: sigma_E_normal, ky: 0}),
   128	    0,
   129	)
   130	oblique_residual = reduced(port_mismatch.subs({sigma_E: sigma_E_normal}))
   131	print(f"oblique residual after normal-incidence sigma_E choice = {oblique_residual}")
   132	assert oblique_residual == reduced(-sig * ky**2 / (mu**2 * s**2 * (s + sig)))
   133	
   134	print("\nAll variable-coefficient Baffet SymPy checks passed.")

   261	\section{正定性、非负耗散与失败机制}
   262	
   263	\subsection{Debye primitive 二次型}
   264	
   265	\[
   266	M_{Pq}=\begin{pmatrix}\alpha&\beta\\ \beta&\gamma\end{pmatrix}.
   267	\]
   268	其行列式为
   269	\[
   270	\alpha\gamma-\beta^2
   271	=b+ab\tau+2a^3\tau+b(2a^2-b)\tau^2.
   272	\]
   273	在 \(\sx,\sy\ge0\) 时
   274	\[
   275	2a^2-b=2\sx^2+3\sx\sy+2\sy^2\ge0,
   276	\]
   277	故在 \(a>0\)、\(\tau>0\) 且角 PML 中 \(b>0\) 时该块正定。边 PML 中 \(b=0\)
   278	时 primitive 变量的若干方向退化，必须单独处理。
   279	
   280	\subsection{理想耗散非负条件}
   281	
   282	\[
   283	\Gamma_1(I+a^{-1}\Gamma_1)
   284	=\diag\left(\sx\left(1+\frac{\sx}{a}\right),
   285	\sy\left(1+\frac{\sy}{a}\right)\right)\ge0,
   286	\]
   287	\[
   288	\frac{b}{a}\ge0,\qquad a^2-b=\sx^2+\sx\sy+\sy^2\ge0,\qquad ab\ge0.
   289	\]
   290	所以在 \(a>0\)、\(\sx,\sy\ge0\)、材料参数正的区域中 \(D_0\ge0\)。若要把
   291	\(R_\sigma\) 吸收到 \(D_0\)，还需要 \(D_0\) 对 \(\|u\|\) 与 \(\|\lambda\|\) 有正
   292	下界；这通常要求角 PML 中 \(\sx,\sy\) 有正下界。边 PML 或物理区不满足该条件。
   293	
   294	\subsection{变量系数余项符号不定}
   295	
   296	即使 \(\sx',\sy'\ge0\)，也不能推出 \(R_\sigma\le0\)。例如在一个开集上
   297	\(\sx'>0\)、\(\sy'=0\)。若取 \(u\ge0\) 且 \(\lambda_x<0\)，则
   298	\[
   299	-u\sx'\lambda_x>0,
   300	\]
   301	使 \(R_\sigma\) 对能量导数作正贡献；若 \(\lambda_x>0\)，该项才为负。变量
   302	\(\lambda\) 是动态未知量，其符号不由阻尼剖面的单调性决定。因此 ``阻尼递增''
   303	不是单调能量证明。

   305	\section{小梯度吸收定理}
   306	
   307	设在角 PML 子区域 \(\Omega_c\) 中边界通量非正，并有常数 \(m_u,m_\lambda>0\)

   310	D_0(t)\ge m_u\|u\|_{L^2(\Omega_c)}^2
   311	+m_\lambda\|\lambda\|_{L^2(\Omega_c)}^2+\hbox{其他非负项}.

   313	令 \(g=\|\nabla a\|_{L^\infty(\Omega_c)}\)。由 Cauchy--Schwarz，
   314	\[

   319	-m_u u^2-m_\lambda\lambda^2+g u\lambda

   349	\section{Port 模型能量与匹配性分离验证}
   350	
   351	新 PDF 的 port 模型为
   352	\begin{align}
   353	\eps E_t+P_t+\eps\sigma_E E&=\partial_xW_y-\partial_yW_x,\label{eq:port-E}\\
   354	\mu W_{x,t}+\mu\sy W_x&=-\partial_yE,\label{eq:port-Wx}\\
   355	\mu W_{y,t}+\mu\sx W_y&=\partial_xE,\label{eq:port-Wy}\\
   356	\tau P_t+P&=\kappa E.\label{eq:port-P}
   357	\end{align}
   358	若 \(\sx=\sy=\sigma_E=0\)，并识别 \(W_x=H_x,W_y=H_y\)，则
   359	\eqref{eq:port-E}--\eqref{eq:port-P} 退化为物理 Maxwell--Debye 系统。
   360	
   361	\subsection{端口能量}
   362	
   363	定义
   364	\[
   365	\Ecal_{\rm port}(t)=\frac12\int_\Omega
   366	\left(\eps E^2+\mu W_x^2+\mu W_y^2+\kappa^{-1}P^2\right)\dd x\dd y.
   367	\]
   368	将 \eqref{eq:port-E}--\eqref{eq:port-Wy} 分别乘以 \(E,W_x,W_y\)，空间项满足
   369	\[

   371	=\partial_x(EW_y)-\partial_y(EW_x).
   372	\]
   373	并且
   374	\[
   375	EP_t=\frac1{2\kappa}\partial_t(P^2)+\frac{\tau}{\kappa}P_t^2.
   376	\]
   377	因此
   378	\[
   379	\boxed{
   380	\frac{\dd}{\dd t}\Ecal_{\rm port}(t)
   381	+\int_\Omega\left(
   382	\eps\sigma_EE^2+\mu\sy W_x^2+\mu\sx W_y^2+\frac{\tau}{\kappa}P_t^2
   383	\right)\dd x\dd y
   384	=\int_{\partial\Omega}E(W_y n_x-W_xn_y)\dd s.}
   385	\]

   397	Y_0=\frac{H_y}{E}=\frac{\nu_0}{\mu s},\qquad

   406	\]

   408	\[
   409	\frac{W_y}{E}=\frac{\nu}{\mu(s+\sigma)}
   410	\]

   412	\[
   413	Y_{\rm port}^2
   414	=\frac{s\eps_D(s)+\eps\sigma_E}{\mu(s+\sigma)}
   415	+\frac{k_y^2}{\mu^2s(s+\sigma)}.
   416	\]

   425	=\frac{\eps\sigma_E-\sigma\eps_D(s)}{\mu(s+\sigma)}

   427	\label{eq:port-mismatch}
